title: Digital Latin Library — Library of Digital Latin Texts (LDLT)
institution: Digital Latin Library (joint project of the Society for Classical Studies, the Medieval Academy of America, and the Renaissance Society of America; hosted at the University of Oklahoma)
period: mixed (Antiquity to early modern; many Renaissance-era Latin texts)
notes:
Publishes peer-reviewed, born-digital TEI critical editions (the LDLT series, encoded according to published LDLT TEI guidelines) of Latin texts from all eras. A substantial share of recent volumes are Renaissance-era Latin works and the Renaissance Society of America is a partner, but the scope is not limited to 1450–1700 — flagged for human review of fit. Main site verified live.

Justification: An established publisher of TEI critical editions with a strong Renaissance component among its partner societies; found via re3data/TEI-wiki-oriented search results pointing to the LDLT encoding guidelines. Not in the catalogue (the catalogue lists Perseus but not the Digital Latin Library).
Found at: https://digitallatin.github.io/guidelines/LDLT-Guidelines.html
